visualInspection.notes: Phase2 diagram: random sinusoidal torques are bounded by actuator limits; frequencies are below half the joint natural frequencies (≤5 Hz in this example). Validation uses novel torques, ODE integration and comparison with real motion. The5 ms interval is200 Hz;58000 contiguous samples span289.995 s from first to last, whereas NΔt is290 s. slides.lectureTitle: Implementation of AI to Robot Dynamics
slides.title: Deep Lagrangian NN: Equation of Motion

visualInspection.notes: Torque is printed as Hddq+Hdotdq−0.5∇T+∇V, while the bottom defines T=dqᵀHdq and calls it kinetic energy. The torque expression is consistent with this doubled-energy definition, but physical kinetic energy is K=0.5dqᵀHdq and then the subtraction is −∇K. H and V alone describe the stated conservative model, not arbitrary friction or contact forces. Footer20. Actual 1800×1013 pixels inspected alongside text.

slides.lectureTitle: Implementation of AI to Robot Dynamics
slides.title: Summary

visualInspection.notes: Summary introduces RNEA and ABA names, parameter/rigid-body assumptions, learned models and physics structure. Forward shorthand τ→acceleration omits conditioning on current q,dq. Energy conservation requires unforced conservative assumptions; for applied torque the proper statement is power balance, and dissipation needs additional terms. Improved generalization and future foundation/self-updating models are prospects, not unconditional guarantees. Footer30. Actual 1800×1013 pixels inspected alongside text.
